scenario: LEXP.7.20: two schema-typed slot reads are equal exactly when they name the same fact. Parents 1 and 2; Specs ask for Child 1 and Child 2 under Parent 1 and Child 3 under Parent 2, and `make` emits each with its `parent` slot set ([LGRA.5.7a.2]). `sib` (`Child c, Child d where c.parent == d.parent and c != d`) fires for the two children of Parent 1, each way round, and never across parents or for a child with itself. Exactly ["sib 1/2", "sib 2/1"]: `make`'s terminal is first, so every child enters before `sib` fires; both of `sib`'s matches complete when Child 2 enters, and LDET.5.5 orders them lexicographically, Child 1 first. PATH PINNED: the join test, scanned; libds `rete/eval.c` `val_eq_unordered`'s FACT_REF arm on two slot values, Mercury `ds.eval` `compare_outcome` on two `fact_ref`s.
rules_ds:
schema Parent scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema Spec scope logical:
    id: Int key
    parent: Int mutable

schema Child scope logical:
    id: Int key
    parent: Parent mutable

rule make:
    Spec s
    Parent p where p.id == s.parent
->
    emit Child logical id: s.id parent: p

rule sib:
    Child c
    Child d where c.parent == d.parent and c != d
->
    log info "sib {c.id}/{d.id}"
